in_hindi.name: वीरल
in_hindi.long_meaning: वीरल (vīral) - full of energy, lively, infectious, spreading.

in_marathi.name: Viral
in_marathi.long_meaning: Viral हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Virala', meaning 'rising' or 'spreading'. It is a powerful name that represents the fierce and infectious energy of the sun, as well as the passion and determination that drives individuals to rise above challenges and spread positivity in their lives.
